notes.nodes: vertebrae per section, used for the cable-length chord correction in constantCurvature
notes.robotRadius: mm, radius of the circle the tendons run on
notes.sectL: mm, nominal (straight, uncompressed) length of each section
notes.spoolRadius: mm of cable per rad of motor shaft (10 mm shaft diameter / 2)
notes.toolLength: mm, straight rigid tool on the end of section 2
notes.rotationalOffset: rad, angle from the robot's x axis to tendon A
notes.tendonAnglesDeg: tendon positions relative to tendon A. Section 1: A..F (all six run through it). Section 2: A, C, E (B, D, F end at the joint)
notes.sMinRatio: shortest allowed section length as a fraction of sectL (sMin = sMinRatio*sectL, sMax = sectL)
notes.thetaMaxDeg: largest allowed bend angle k*s per section
notes.motorLimit: rad, commands are clamped to +/- this (the STM32 trips at 20 rad). Used by PCC_Cable and Poly
